title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit — Arrival Allowance for Home Delivery Shipments in Lost-Medication Replacements
content:
**Clause.** For a lost, stolen or damaged medication replacement under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, a Home Delivery Pharmacy shipment's days are counted from its arrival. After a standard shipment they start the Home Delivery Pharmacy program's standard shipping time in business days plus 2, counted as calendar days, after the shipment date. After a two-day, overnight or cold-chain shipment they start 2 calendar days after it. A retail fill's days start on its date of service.

The shipping method is read from the shipped Home Delivery Pharmacy order; the standard shipping time is the figure set by the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy program.

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. A standard shipment dated September 1 under a program whose standard shipping time is 4 business days: 4 plus 2 gives 6, so the lost supply's days start on September 7.
2. A two-day shipment dated September 1: the days start on September 3.
3. An overnight shipment dated September 1: the days start on September 3.
4. A retail fill dated September 1: the days start on September 1.

A shipment whose days start later keeps more days not yet run out on any given day: a 30-day standard shipment from case 1 has 30 less 3, that is 27, days left on September 10, where a retail fill of September 1 would have 21.
